Stir-fried Cabbage And Peanut Rolls

We feel your kids will definitely start loving vegetables when they are served in this fashion.

5 minPreparation
10 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Heat oil in a pan; add mustard seeds and peanuts and fry till mustard seeds splutter.
  2. Add the curry leaves, green chilli and onion, and fry till the onions turn golden brown. Add the turmeric powder and stir to mix.
  3. Add chopped cabbage and salt and mix well. Add ¼ cup water and cook, covered, for 5 minutes. Stir in Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and coriander leaves and mix well.
  4. Cook till cabbage is tender and remove from heat; leave to cool for a few minutes.
  5. Add coconut to this and mix well.
  6. Place the filling on the chapattis and roll-up. Serve with Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup.
